findings.finding: The in-image title reads 'the folklore photon-counting floor fails in two directions' and paper_draft.tex:162 asserts 'Fig.~\ref{fig:folklore} plots both failures', but ONLY failure (B) (exponentially fail-open as an average-error screen) is plotted. The source docstring at visualizations.py:14719 likewise claims 'showing BOTH kernel-checked failure directions'. Note the sub-crossover region where the amber curve sits ABOVE the blue floor is NOT direction (A): it is merely the conservative regime of direction (B).
findings.fix: Preferred: add a third panel (or inset) plotting the admissible unit-threshold counter's miss probability e^{-N_a} against the folklore e^{-(N_a-N_b)} at N_b = 5, with the (5,10) marker annotated '148x' (true e^5 = 148.41). Then the title is earned. Alternative if the 2-panel layout is fixed: retitle to 'the folklore photon-counting floor is exponentially fail-open as an average-error screen', correct the docstring, and rewrite paper_draft.tex:162 to 'Fig.~\ref{fig:folklore} plots the second failure.'

cross_figure_findings.finding: All three PNGs carry a rendered in-image title ('D12 Fig. 1 -- ...') in addition to their LaTeX \caption, duplicating the caption and consuming ~9% of figure height in a single-column float. This is consistent across the project's figure corpus, so it reads as house style rather than a defect of these three -- flagged for an operator decision, not as a required fix.
cross_figure_findings.fix: Optional: add a for_paper=True argument that sets title=None on the publication render while the notebook/dashboard variants keep titles.

summary: D12's three figures are numerically sound: every Lean-certified value the brief named was reproduced exactly (crossover 51.396 with fail-open shading correctly starting there and not before; log 4 = 1.38629; gap exponent 9.544512 and ratio 3491.96 > 1000 at (50,60); ENBW*T floor 1/2 saturated by the boxcar with the ramp at 2/3; tau_eff negative on the unstable branch; Johnson correction |1-L| giving 2 at L = 3 and 4 at both L = 5 and L = -3). The brief's primary physics trap -- shading the whole range of fig1 rather than only the post-crossover fail-open region -- is passed. The bundle nonetheless does NOT meet the ALL-PASS criterion: fig2 carries two hard rendering FAILs (a 3-row legend that overprints both x-axis titles into illegibility, and a literal '^{}' exponent in the Chernoff legend that kaleido renders verbatim), and fig1 carries a MAJOR overclaim -- its title and the body sentence at tex:162 promise 'two directions'/'both failures' while only the fail-open average-error direction is plotted; the false-strict miss-bound refutation (148x at (5,10)) is absent from the figure entirely. Thirteen MINOR items follow, chiefly annotation/curve collisions, one red-green envelope pairing in fig2's right panel, one off-palette fill, and the fact that fig3's stability-blindness claim is stated but not made visible for want of an L = -1 marker in the right panel.
recommendations: BLOCKING (fig2): re-render with height=560, margin b=170 and legend y=-0.30 so 'integration window T' and 'separation budget z = Delta-mu/(2 sigma)' are legible.
BLOCKING (fig2): replace the literal 'e^{-z^2/2}' in the Chernoff legend with a Unicode/plain form.

BLOCKING (fig1): either add the missing miss-bound panel (unit-threshold e^{-N_a} vs folklore at N_b = 5, marking 148x at (5,10)) so the 'two directions' title is earned, or narrow the title, the docstring at visualizations.py:14719 and paper_draft.tex:162 to the single failure actually plotted. Per the project's correctness-over-expediency standard the added panel is preferred to the walk-back.

fig1: label the right-panel witness marker '9.5445' and move the log 4 annotation to 'bottom right'; draw the crossover vline at the analytic root and quantify it as N_a = 51.40 in both figure and caption.

fig2: rename the slack fill so it does not imply the realizable set is bounded above by 2/3; retitle the right y-axis 'tail probability / bound'; recolor Mills off green; use COLORS['steel_blue'] for the fill; draw the floor hline below the boxcar trace; add units to the T axis.

fig3: move the three witness labels off the curve, move the marginal annotation off the stable branch, add an L = -1 boundary to the RIGHT panel so stability-blindness is visible, and set the right y-range to [0, 5.4] to stop the corner clipping.
